{{Top|leg}}
The '''HydroExtractor''' was capable of extracting a [[Liter/Legends|liter]] of almost 100 percent pure [[Water/Legends|water]] from most [[Alien/Legends|alien]] sources of water within five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], and from a dry [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in between four and twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Extraction from a humid atmosphere took less time. It required at least an hour's charging after every use.
